snippet.title: Thumbylina 2nd PV | LeonaSoftware
snippet.description:
This game is designed for an open-source hardware device called Thumby, which is about the size of a fingertip. When studying or exercising, you can set a timer in the game, and the character Thumbylina in the game will also improve herself through studying or exercising, gradually unlocking new outfits and hairstyles. Smartphones and PCs often receive endless notifications, making it difficult to concentrate even when using a timer app. However, Thumbylina is completely disconnected from the network, allowing for true focus. In the future, we plan to develop a dedicated keychain-type device and expand its reach widely.

More information↓
https://www.thumbylina.tokyo/
